name: io.github.ravi-p-k-1/insightiq
description: Look up real FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) series and their historical observations. Returns raw retrieved data only, so the calling agent analyzes it and writes the explanation.

environmentVariables.name: FRED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FRED API key. Get a free one at https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html

environmentVariables.name: FRED_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: caps outgoing FRED request rate. Defaults to 120, matching FRED's documented limit.
